content:
ajay: Heads-up: rolling svc-search 2.4.0 in tonight's change window (22:00 UTC). Plan is staged feature-flag ramp for `search-v2-route` across regions. please read and ack.

maria: ack — what's the initial % and cadence?

ajay: start at 5% global for 10m, then 20% for 15m, 50% for 20m, then full. region slices: EU first, then NA, then APAC.

sylvie: mention in runbook: if error-rate bump >0.3% or p95 latency +200ms over baseline for 5m -> rollback to pinned v1 and drain cohort.

kevin: adding small tweak — pin traffic for high-value accounts to v1 for the first 30m (`cohort_pin: business=true`). avoids noisy regressions.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled by ajay. Run ID: rb-1762504321. Commands: `/deploy svc-search --image=redwood/svc-search:2.4.0 --ff=search-v2-route:5% --pin=cohort:business=true`

ops-oncall: I'll watch infra metrics and the canary dashboard. Paging policy set to pager if errors >0.5% sustained 3m.

maria: release notes snippet: "search: improve reranking quality and reduce cold-start latency; opt-in via feature flag `search-v2-route`. Rollout staged across regions; high-value accounts pinned to v1 for safety."

ajay: also note: if model route falls back frequently, the routing-telemetry will auto-switch after 2m to compat fallback — that will be noisy but safe. If that happens escalate to eng-runtime.

sylvie: cross-check: telemetry hooks added? we should have the prompt-set smoke tests firing after each step.

kevin: smoke tests in CI are green. I'll run the synthetic prompt set post-deploy step script: `scripts/smoke/run_region_checks.sh eu` and paste results here.

deploybot: Deploy started (rb-1762504321). Step 1: push image -> success. Step 2: enable ff at 5% in EU -> success.

maria: EU 5% perf looks fine, no error bump :thumbsup: proceeding to 20% in EU at T+10m.

ops-oncall: noticing slight qps spike but within 95th perc baseline. continuing to monitor.

sylvie: reminder: if we hit the rollback criteria, use `ffctl set search-v2-route 0%` then `pin-service svc-search 2.3.9` and notify customers. runbook snippet in case:```bash
ffctl set search-v2-route 0%
pinctl set svc-search --version=2.3.9 --reason="rollback due to perf"
```

ajay: good. I'm on standby. if all goes well we'll hit 50% EU by +25m then start NA slice.

deploybot: Step 3: EU -> 20% success. Smoke tests: OK. Next tick scheduled in 15m.

maria: ack. tagging release-notes PR (#4367) with the rollout schedule and pin notes.

kevin: FYI I'll leave a small throttling guard in place for NA rollout to keep token cost loss low if we see model drift.

ops-oncall: if we need to do emergency drain, I'll run `drain-cohort --tag=eu:search-v2` and open an incident channel.

sylvie: final: don't forget to close the run in the console and mark the commit in changelog with the ff ramp percentages and timestamps.

ajay: thanks everyone. post-mortem if anything odd, otherwise I'll mark this successful after full ramp. :partyparrot:
